question: which universities did dr wend-benedo emmanuel zongo defend his phd under a cotutelle between
answer: Université Sorbonne Paris-Nord and Università degli di Studi di Milano.
evidence: He defended his Ph.D degree (on January 10, 2022) in control theory of PDEs and calculus of variations in cotutelle between the Université Sorbonne Paris-Nord and Università degli di Studi di Milano.
